name: attio-app
description: NestJS CRM API with a Next.js UI for sequences and workflows

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server run start:demo" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
